promises.label: FY26 services revenue growth guidance raised
promises.quote: we are raising our full year services revenue growth guidance to 4.75% to 5.25% in constant currency terms
promises.speaker: Shiv Walia

promises.label: FY26 company revenue growth guidance
promises.quote: the company level guidance to 4% to 4.5% in constant currency terms
promises.speaker: Shiv Walia

promises.label: FY26 EBIT margin guidance 17-18%
promises.quote: We remain on track to deliver on our full year EBIT margin guidance of 17% to 18%
promises.speaker: Shiv Walia

promises.label: Restructuring ~50bps impact in Q4 too
promises.quote: we expect the similar kind of impact in Q4 also. Our endeavour is to finish this exercise by Q4
promises.speaker: Shiv Walia

promises.label: Labour code recurring impact 10-20bps
promises.quote: going forward, we don't expect this to be more than 10 to 20 basis points on a recurring basis
promises.speaker: Shiv Walia

promises.label: Margin recovery of 13bps YoY dip
promises.quote: our operating margin in Q3 is down marginally 13 basis points YoY, and we are confident of recovering that as well in the future
promises.speaker: C. Vijayakumar

promises.label: ~$2.5bn quarterly net new bookings average
promises.quote: if you take some kind of a moving average over 3 quarters, 2 quarters, then I think we should be hitting that number
promises.speaker: C. Vijayakumar

reported.label: Q3 revenue $3.79bn, +4.8% YoY cc
reported.quote: Our revenue for Q3 came in at $3.79 billion, a growth of 4.8% YoY and 4.2% on a QoQ in constant currency terms

reported.label: Crossed $15 billion annualized revenue
reported.quote: This quarter, we also crossed $15 billion of annualized revenue

reported.label: Net new bookings $3bn, +43% YoY
reported.quote: Our net new bookings were strong at $3 billion, which is a 17% QoQ and 43% YoY growth

reported.quote: came at 18.6%, a 111 basis points QoQ and a decrease of 94 basis points YoY

reported.label: Software revenue $425mn, +28.1% QoQ
